items.summary: Investing.com -- Lowe’s Companies Inc (LOW) beat on the top and bottom lines, but gross margin took the hit. The stock closed at $222.78 on Nov 18 (3:59 PM EST). Pre-market was $218.56 (-1.89%) as of 9:22 AM EST Nov 19, as the market weighed the margin detail more than the headline beat.
